# kryfo signatures, version 1: xeddsa by a libsignal identity key over
# "kryfo-sig-v1" 00 context 00 message, the message a whole body of the
# context's format without its own signature (formats_v1.txt has the frames).
# xeddsa is randomised, so these are only checked, never made again
# (src/tests_sig.rs). test keys only
# key name private public
# good name key context message text signature
# bad name refused-as lax|strict public context message signature
#   lax: libsignal's own verify takes it, only the shim refuses it
# prekey key public signature: libsignal's own prekey signature
# alt key other signature: libsignal's alternate identity signature
